notes.torque_gain: Uncalibrated moment surrogate. 25 PSI is a source command, not a validated joint torque.
notes.direction: Extension is an explicit assumption for the legacy single-channel pressure path; verify against the hardware configuration.
notes.emg: Muscle activation-group proxies are not measured EMG or subject-calibrated legacy EMG integrals.
notes.adaptation: Reflex feedback is immediate mechanical response. Long-term human learning/fatigue is not calibrated or simulated.
notes.device_default: reset() collects unassisted gait first. Assistance is enabled only after that baseline passes; set false for an unassisted comparison.
notes.exosuit: Photo-inspired rendering and assumed carried mass/inertia, joint drag, pressure lag and torque gain. No FEM, cuff slip or tissue-contact prediction. 30 PSI is a simulation clamp, not a hardware rating.
notes.baseline: Unpowered comparison retains the same worn device mass and damping; use bare_config.json for the bare human.
